influences.name: Casey MQ
influences.context: I left Europe for a bit more than a month, reunited with friends, and kept working with one of them (Casey MQ) who I knew would be the best partner for me to write the story.

influences.context: Here, the artist sits down with fellow moody electro-pop maven FKA twigs, one of her early sonic inspirations.
